Beta people,
dey come closer.
index.hero.sub: GGanbu Chat dey help adults wey dey near each other start respect conversation, understand each other even if dem no speak the same language, and build real friendship—straight through Bluetooth.
index.hero.note: No need account · No random matching · Na you choose who you wan talk with
index.meaning.title: Person wey you fit trust, no be for sex.
index.meaning.lead: “GGanbu” mean person wey be your close and reliable friend—person wey you fit talk to open-open and treat well. This app na for healthy, non-sexual talk between adults wey get respect.
index.meaning.p1: Friendly connection wey build on how dem like each other and respect.
index.meaning.p2: Clear control for visibility, blocking, and reporting
index.meaning.p3: No random matching or pressure to reply
index.features.eyebrow: E design so that people fit talk better
index.features.title: Simple teknology. Human connection.
index.features.lead: GGanbu Chat make talking with people wey dey near you direct, and e give you better tools to connect well.
index.feat.1.t: Direct chat with people wey dey near you
index.feat.1.d: Bluetooth Low Energy dey help devices wey dey near each other find and connect direct. The main chats no dey pass through any central chat server.
index.feat.2.d: Use one Ollama-compatible endpoint wey you don set up to see the original message and the translation together, so that talking go easy.
index.feat.3.d: iOS and Android dey use the same nearby protocol, so no matter which phone person get, dem fit connect with you.
index.feat.4.d: If una two like each other, una go become GGanbu—pals wey trust each other and choose say make dem stay connected.
index.feat.5.d: Send photos and text direct through Bluetooth, and share your daily levels with people wey you trust.
index.feat.6.d: Choose when people fit see you, delete your chats, and block or report people wey dey misbehave. GGanbu Chat na for adults wey don reach 18 years and above.
index.how.title: You get full control from the first 'hello'.
index.how.lead: Set up your profile, choose when make people see you, and decide who you wan talk with.
index.step.1.d: Create profile, give the permissions wey nearby chat need, and choose when make people fit find you.
index.step.2.t: See people wey dey near you
index.step.2.d: Adults wey allow people find dem for the same cafe, library, event, or any place una share, go show based on how far dem dey via Bluetooth.
index.step.3.d: Pick any profile wey dey near you and start to chat. If you use the translation option, e go help una understand each other well.
index.lang.title: Even if una no speak the same language, una fit still feel close.
index.lang.lead: If you don set up compatible translation endpoint, GGanbu Chat fit help translate conversation and e go still keep the original message for there.
index.dl.title: Your next GGanbu fit dey near you.
index.dl.lead: Download GGanbu Chat for iOS or Android to connect with people wey dey near you in a respectful and responsible way. Na for adults 18+.

privacy.meta.title: Privacy Policy — GGanbu Chat
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: GGanbu Chat ("di app," "we," "us," or "our") na nearby communication app wey di developer wey dey for app-store listing provide. Core chats dey go straight from one device to another through Bluetooth, no be through central chat server. Some other things you fit choose to do, like translation, safety reports, and in-app purchases, dey use network or platform services as we explain below. Dis Privacy Policy go tell you which information we dey handle, why we need am, who we fit share am with, how long we go keep am, and di choices wey you get.
privacy.s1.p: Depending on di things wey you choose for di app, na dis kind information di app dey handle:
privacy.s1.l1: Profile and contact information — your display name and, if you choose to give am, your profile photo and email address. Other people wey dey near you fit see your profile as long as you allow them find you. We go only share your email with another person if both of una show GGanbu interest, and e fit dey inside safety report wey you choose to send.
privacy.s1.l2: User content — messages and photos wey una send to each other dey stay for di devices and dem dey go straight through Bluetooth. If you send safety report, di report fit get di message wey you report, recent things wey una talk, and photos wey you get from di person wey you report.
privacy.s1.l3: Device and proximity information — one random app identifier dey help us know who dey near. Bluetooth signal strength (RSSI) dey help us know how far you dey. Di app no dey use RSSI to find or save GPS coordinates.
privacy.s1.l4: Report, app, and purchase information — one report fit get di name of di person wey report and di person wey dem report, reporter email, why dem report and di time, app version, and encrypted copy of di reported user's app identifier. Apple or Google fit give purchase status and transaction identifiers wey needed to complete or bring back in-app purchase.
privacy.s2.t: 2. How we dey use and share information
privacy.s2.p: We only dey use information to help you find people near you and make devices talk to each other, do the translation wey you ask for, finish buy-buy things, stop bad behavior, answer reports and help requests, and follow the law. Your profile info and wetin you chat dey share only with people near you wey you choose to talk to. Translation text go go to the translation endpoint wey you set; Apple or Google go handle buy-buy info; and reports go pass through your email provider go reach our safety person. If we pick service provider to help us process information, we go make sure say dem follow the privacy rules for this policy; but services wey you pick yourself, na their own rules and privacy ways dem dey follow. We no dey sell personal info, use am for other people advertisement, or run any advertisement or cross-app tracking SDKs. We no dey keep regular copies of your direct chats for any central chat server.
privacy.s3.t: 3. Permission and wetin pipol go see
privacy.s3.l1: Bluetooth / Nearby devices — na for to find, let others see you, connect, and share things with devices wey dey near you. This permissions important for the app to work, but you fit change am for your system settings.
privacy.s3.l2: Location (Android 11 and earlier) — old Android versions need location permission for Bluetooth scanning. For new versions wey the app support, e go ask for Nearby devices permissions, and we declare say we no dey use Bluetooth scanning to find where you dey exactly. We no dey collect or send GPS coordinates.
privacy.s3.l3: Photos and notifications — the app only go touch the photos wey you pick for your profile or chat. Notification permission na to tell you when message enter and to help Bluetooth work where the operating system need am. You fit say 'no' or change these optional permissions for your system settings.
privacy.s3.l4: Discoverability — na you decide when other people wey dey near you fit see your profile. When e active, the app go use Bluetooth tell others about your profile so dem fit find you. You fit stop this thing anytime using the antenna control. The app no dey put you for map or just so-so match you enter chat.
privacy.s4.p: Translation no be compulsory, but you need to set an Ollama-compatible endpoint for the app. When you ask for translation, the message text, how to translate am, the language, and model request go go to that endpoint through your local network or internet, depending on the address wey you set. The person wey run the endpoint fit see normal network info like your IP address, and na dem be in charge of their own security, logging, keeping data, and privacy ways. We no get control over the endpoints wey you pick yourself. If no endpoint dey, you fit still use direct Bluetooth chat without translation.
privacy.s5.t: 5. How we dey keep, protect, hold and delete information
privacy.s5.l1: Delete a conversation — this one go remove the chat from your device. E no go delete copies wey other people don already receive, save, or report.
privacy.s5.p: Profiles, conversations, blocks, and the app-generated identifier usually dey stay for your device as far as the app or that record still dey there. The operating system's protection features dey safeguard local app data. Bluetooth and network transmission security also depend on the devices wey dey use am, configured endpoint, network, and email provider. No way to store or send things wey completely secure.
privacy.s5.l2: Block person — e go save the block for your device so dat the person no go fit see your profile again or send you message. You fit manage people wey you don block inside the app.
privacy.s5.l3: Send report — e go first block the person wey you report, den e go open one email draft make you check am. If you send am, your email provider go send the report and any evidence wey you pick go our safety contact. We encrypt the app identifier for the developer, but your email provider na dem dey handle the email body and photo archive. We go keep reports only as far as e necessary to investigate, follow our rules, protect users, settle palaver, and follow law; after dat, we go delete am or make e no identify who do am.
privacy.s5.l4: Uninstall or ask make dem delete — if you uninstall, e normally dey remove app data from your device, but some things fit still dey for operating-system backups or with people wey receive message and service providers. Since no be so dat the app get account, there no be server account to delete. To ask make we delete report or support record wey we get, contact us below; we fit keep some info if law say so or if na for safety and to stop fraud.
privacy.s6.p: Apple App Store or Google Play na dem dey handle in-app purchases according to their own terms and privacy policy. We no dey receive or save your full card number or other payment details. The app and store fit exchange info about product, transaction, purchase-status, and device/account wey dem need to process, verify, use, or bring back purchase.
privacy.s7.p: This app na for adults wey don reach 18 years and above. E no be for children, and anybody wey never reach 18 no suppose use am. If you think say pikin don give info through report or support request, contact us make we investigate and delete am if e correct.
privacy.s8.p: You fit look or change your profile, stop make people find you, take back permissions, manage people wey you block, delete chats, stop to use translation endpoint, or uninstall the app. Depending on where you dey live, you fit get rights to see, correct, delete, restrict, object to, or get copy of personal info wey we hold, and to withdraw your consent without affecting wetin don happen before. Contact us to use these rights. You fit also complain to your local data-protection authority. We fit need to verify who you be before we do anything.
privacy.s9.p: We fit update this policy if the app, how we dey work, or law change. We go post the new policy here and update the date for top. If any change affect how we use info seriously, we go give extra notice or ask for consent as law demand.
privacy.s10.p: If you get any question about this Privacy Policy, abeg contact us for:
